datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators across Afghanistan on a monthly basis (January, April, July, October 2013) through field assessments. Geographic polygons represent administrative units classified into IPC phases indicating severity of acute food insecurity, with scenario variations and assistance requirements documented.
